summary: Iter206 — Validated Pool config: public GET /api/config/pool, admin save (service-config/pool), enforcement in POST /api/rides (ineligible vehicle, disallowed payment, too many stops), Advanced Taxi estimate non-regression for real slugs, and AdminPoolConfig.js UI loads with all data-testids and persists selections after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rides.py is very large (>1000 lines) and mixes ride creation, status transitions, bidding, pool, cancellation, route updates. Consider splitting into rides_create.py, rides_status.py, rides_pool.py for maintainability.

config.py — GLOBAL Pool config exposed via get_pool_global_config() reads from service_configs[pool].settings; admin save endpoint lives in routes/admin.py PUT /admin/service-config/{service_key}. There is no Pydantic validation on the pool settings payload (e.g. negative pool_percentage or non-string slug entries). Recommend a SaveServiceConfig model to enforce bounds.
Pool enforcement in create_ride correctly returns 400 with explicit French messages and verifies vehicle eligibility, payment method whitelist, and max_stops — good UX.

Frontend AdminPoolConfig.js exposes all required data-testids (admin-pool-config, pool-enable-toggle, pool-pool_percentage, pool-available_seats, pool-max_seats_per_booking, pool-max_stops, pool-share_discount_percent, pool-eligible-vehicles + pool-vehicle-<slug>, pool-payment-methods + pool-payment-cash/card/wallet/sbpaygo, pool-save-btn). Persistence verified after reload.
test_credentials: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (admin); TEST_pool_rider_iter206@example.com / Rider2026! (rider, auto-created by tests)
seed_data_creation: Tests temporarily restrict pool to [sb, confort] + cash-only, then RESTORE permissive config (eligible_vehicle_slugs=[], all payments enabled) in the final teardown test. No leftover restrictive state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Pool API verified end-to-end. Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter206_pool_config.py and are idempotent (auto register+login rider; restore permissive pool config at the end). Frontend admin route /admin/pool-config is fully wired with data-testids. Not exhaustively tested: RideChoosePage /course?mode=pool client-side filtering (effectiveVtypes/effectivePayments memos consuming /api/config/pool) — recommended next pass if you need full E2E of the rider Pool flow. AdvancedTaxiBookingPage estimate non-regression for slugs sb/confort/luxe/airport/moto passes via /api/rides/estimate.
